_comment: intake island toolchain (homelab#3577): ONLY what the pod image lacks — promtool (package prometheus, cli output) and yq (package yq-go). The sitting's pod is the worker base image (agent-base), whose /nix store already holds claude, git, curl, jq, gh, kubectl, s5cmd, python3 and uv on the login PATH, so nothing the image pre-bakes is installed a second time at a different version. The bootstrap in agents/coordinator/island-intake-argo.yaml runs the launcher through `devbox run` in THIS directory. Versions: the repo-root devbox.lock's entries, copied. The repo-root devbox.json/devbox.lock are never touched.
